description: Part-to-whole as nested rings: each item is an arc whose angle shows its share of the total, the top-level groups sit in the innermost ring and each level of the optional per-item path (1 to 3 group names, top down) is one ring further out, so a budget, a disk-usage breakdown or a folder tree reads from the inside out. Laid out by d3-hierarchy partition() and drawn with d3-shape arc() paths on the server, so there is no script. With the optional layout "icicle" the same hierarchy is drawn as horizontal bars instead, the top-level groups in the left column and each level one column further right. A group's hue follows its top-level group and each ring out is a lighter shade of it; every arc or bar carries its name, path, value and share in a hover title and in the hidden table (item, path, value, share of total), and the aria label gives the total, the number of groups and the largest group. Labels are drawn only where they fit and are rotated to read outward, never upside down; the centre of the ring shows the total. Motion-ready: every moving value reads --p (build progress 0 to 1, default 1) through a per-ring --k, so a motion_timeline track on p builds it ring by ring from the inside out and the standalone render is the finished picture; reduced motion shows the end state.
